name: ELSCINT1/PMSCT_RLE1 Delta Decoding
definition: Decodes a custom RLE + Delta compressed byte stream used by ELSCINT1/PMSCT medical imaging devices into a sequence of 16-bit unsigned integers.
summary: ELSCINT1/PMSCT_RLE1 Delta Decoding converts medical imaging byte streams into 16-bit integers using unique escape markers and a two-pass RLE-then-delta process.
